rules.name: Confidentiality survival term
rules.flagIf: Survival period is reduced below 5 years or trade secret carve-out is removed
rules.note: Survival period or trade secret protection weakened

rules.name: Confidential information definition
rules.flagIf: Definition narrowed to require written/electronic markings, excluding oral disclosures
rules.note: Confidentiality scope narrowed or marking requirement added

rules.name: Confidentiality exclusions
rules.flagIf: Exclusions broadened beyond standard (public domain, prior knowledge, independent development, legal compulsion)

rules.name: Governing law and jurisdiction
rules.flagIf: Governing law or jurisdiction changed from the baseline

rules.name: Agreement term / duration
rules.flagIf: Base term of agreement reduced from baseline

rules.name: Termination notice period
rules.flagIf: Minimum notice period introduced or existing notice period changed

rules.name: Standard of care for confidentiality
rules.flagIf: Standard weakened from 'same degree of care as own confidential information' to lesser standard
rules.note: Standard of care for protecting confidential information weakened

rules.name: Mandatory disclosure / compelled disclosure
rules.flagIf: Notice requirement to disclosing party before compelled disclosure removed or weakened

rules.name: Indemnification and liability
rules.flagIf: Indemnification capped, removed, or limited compared to baseline

rules.name: Return or destruction of materials
rules.flagIf: Obligation to return or destroy confidential information removed or weakened

rules.name: Assignment of agreement
rules.flagIf: Assignment permitted without consent (e.g., to affiliates or acquirers)
rules.note: Assignment permitted without prior written consent

rules.name: Permitted disclosure to agents/employees
rules.flagIf: Permitted disclosure scope broadened beyond need-to-know basis
rules.note: Permitted disclosure scope for agents/employees broadened

rules.name: Data protection compliance
rules.flagIf: Strict compliance duty weakened to reasonable efforts, or mutual indemnification for data breaches removed
rules.note: Data protection obligations weakened or GDPR exposure unmitigated

rules.name: Permitted use restriction
rules.flagIf: Permitted use expanded beyond the specific Opportunity to other purposes
rules.note: Permitted use scope expanded beyond defined Opportunity

rules.name: Equitable relief
rules.flagIf: Right to seek injunctive or equitable relief removed or restricted
rules.note: Equitable relief provision removed or weakened

rules.name: Amendment requirements
rules.flagIf: Written amendment requirement removed or unilateral amendment permitted

rules.name: No licence granted
rules.flagIf: No-licence clause removed or modified to allow implied licence
rules.note: No-licence clause removed — implied licence risk

rules.name: Purpose definition
rules.flagIf: Purpose definition broadened or made ambiguous beyond evaluating the Opportunity
